messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a beta for the new embeddings endpoint. Goal: support variable dims (512/768/1024) and batching up to 2048 total items. Wanted to get alignment on launch criteria.
aj: +1. Key customers: Acme, NovaSearch asked for 512 and 1024. We should default to 768 to match most open models.
leo: Proposed gating: 1) response shape stable (per-input vector ordering), 2) batching >=64 items or 1MB payload, 3) latency p95 <200ms for single-item on dedicated, 4) telemetry for per-dim cost breakdown.
maya: Also need a clear policy for dimension mismatches — reject vs auto-resize. Acme prefers explicit error + migration docs.
samir: Auto-projection would be nice but research-heavy. Recommend error 400 + structured hint pointing to migration guide for v1.
aj: Rollout plan: opt-in beta, 2-week with Acme & NovaSearch, baseline eval (cosine similarity vs current embeddings) and cost telemetry.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> 75% -> 100% over 48h. Flag EMBEDDINGS_V2 created.
leo: API contract draft:
```
request: {"model": "string", "inputs": ["string"], "batch_size": int optional}
response: {"embeddings": [[float]], "model": "string", "dimension": int}
```
Call out deterministic ordering and per-item vector length.
maya: Telemetry required: per-request tokens, batch_size, dimension, model_version, latency_ms, billing_units. Hook into Console dashboards and set alert if cost or quality regression > 10%.
samir: Launch blockers: quantized 1024-dim model failing similarity eval. ETA for fix: 5 business days.
aj: Prioritization decision: if 1024 not ready, ship v1 with 512 & 768 and document 1024 as v1.1. Sounds acceptable?
Acme: @maya we can live with 768 for now; please share timeline for 1024 (Q2 ok).
maya: Agreed. Action items:
- samir: finish quantized eval
- leo: final API schema + compatibility doc
- aj: console metrics + cost estimates
- maya: coordinate beta enrollments (Acme/NovaSearch)
I'll open tickets and tag owners.
leo: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/embeddings-response-shape (link placeholder) — will update here.
aj: I'll propose tenant defaults: max_batch_items=256, max_payload_bytes=1048576 (1MB), default_model="embed-base-768". Will include billing unit calc.
maya: Thanks everyone — reconvene EOD Friday for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
